title: Grateful Dead Live at Vanderbilt University on 1972-10-21
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD -> DC8; this version uses noise reduction; see info file for details

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source, but heavy mid‑boost EQ makes the recording sound thin and overly processed.
ai_review.review: The only available portion of this show has been heavily EQ'd, giving it a mid‑boosted, tube‑screamer‑like thinness that detracts from the listening experience. While the performance itself isn’t described, the technical treatment is criticized despite an overall 4‑star rating.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, focused on recording issues with no musical commentary; rating reflects mixed feelings—positive enough to earn 4 stars but technical flaws lower the overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Heavy EQ applied post‑recording, resulting in a mid‑boosted, thin sound reminiscent of an Ibanez Tube Screamer; overall clarity suffers.
